title: Robot and simulator telemetry record, version 1
description: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines). Written by firmware/pico2/telemetry.py; read by tools/bench/*.py and, later, the simulator replay. tools/telemetry_schema.py implements these rules without third-party packages.

seq.description: record number since boot; gaps mean dropped records

t_ms.description: board milliseconds (time.ticks_ms); compare with differences only

enc.description: left, right encoder counts (x1 decoding, 1120 per output revolution)

cmd.description: commanded duty (-1..1) or target rpm, as the mode defines

pwm.description: duty actually applied after the safety filter

i_a.description: motor currents in A, null until current sensing is wired
